items.title: Robert Glasper interviewed by Greg Thomas, Clinton, New York, February 20, 2016
items.q: The transcript mentions 'Thelonious Monk' only in the interviewer's question referring to 'T.S. Monk, Thelonious Monk’s son'. The interviewee (Robert Glasper) responds about T.S. Monk, stating 'That’s my cousin-in-law', but provides no information about his personal relationship with Thelonious Monk

ctx.x: MR: Thanks for coming early for this, I’m sure it’s going to be a great concert. This is Greg Thomas, class of ’85 and he was in the jazz program, he was in the jazz band and he’s been here for a few days. He had a great lecture the other day. And Robert Glasper, who you all know. He’s got his trio. And I’m going to turn things over to Greg and they’re going to just chat for a while and see what they come up with.
Thank you, Monk. And welcome everyone. Thank you for coming to hear this pre- concert chat. How you doing, man?
Good. I had about a five, six hour drive up here.
